place.name: Ilha de Itamaracá
place.description: Ilha de Itamaracá (Central northeastern portuguese pronunciation: [ˈijɐ di itɐmɐɾɐˈka]) is a tropical island and municipality in Pernambuco, Brazil on the Atlantic Ocean. Itamaracá means "stone shaker" in Tupi, from the words itá ("stone") and mbara'ká ("shaker").
